rounds.text: Fedders Holding Ltd trades at an attractive valuation relative to its peers, with a P/E ratio of 9.69x compared to a sector benchmark of 19.65x and a P/B ratio of 1.23x against a sector benchmark of 2.12x [E5, E6]. The company exhibits robust asset efficiency with an ROA of 10.93%, outperforming the sector benchmark of 2.74% [E7], and benefits from a strong balance sheet as it is almost debt-free [E45]. Market participants are increasingly recognizing these merits, evidenced by a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 and a stellar Sharpe ratio of 3.08 [E38, E41]. Furthermore, insider and institutional confidence is mounting, with promoter holdings increasing by 3.15 percentage points to 65.84% alongside positive institutional money flows [E31, E34]. This accumulation occurs against a supportive macroeconomic backdrop, as the Financial Services sector is operating under a confirmed tailwind with a score of +0.83 [E59]. Conceded: [E13].

Fedders Holding Ltd presents a compelling value and momentum proposition, trading at a P/E of 9.69x against a sector benchmark of 19.65x and a P/B of 1.23x compared to its sector benchmark of 2.12x [E5, E6]. Strong institutional confidence is evident as promoter holdings have increased by 3.15 percentage points to 65.84%, complemented by positive institutional money flows and new stakes from foreign and domestic institutions [E31, E32, E33, E34]. The stock displays exceptional relative strength with a rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 and a high Sharpe ratio of 3.08, supported by historical compounding share price growth of 55% over 5 years [E19, E38, E41]. Furthermore, the company benefits from a favorable macro backdrop with the Financial Services sector operating in a clear tailwind scoring +0.83, alongside the advantage of being almost debt-free [E45, E59]. Conceded: [E13, E16, E17, E49].
